Markets Rally as Rates Hold Steady

By Alex Rivera

The Dow Jones gained 240 points Thursday as the Federal Reserve signaled no change to its benchmark rate.

Analysts said the rally was broad-based, with industrials and energy leading the advance.

"The data suggests the tightening cycle has run its course." — Chief Economist
